How the audit works

Three steps. About a minute.

Every point comes from something a buyer, a reviewer or AI search looks for on the page.

  1. STEP 01

    Paste your listing

    Copy the title, descriptions, highlights and pricing from your public listing page.

  2. STEP 02

    Get a score out of 100

    Up to 10 points per dimension. Six apply to every product; the seventh only if AI agents call yours. Points earned out of points that apply, shown out of 100.

  3. STEP 03

    See your position and fixes

    Your score is placed against 6,900+ live listings scored by the same rules. The three fixes worth the most points come first.

DimensionWhat earns the points
1 · AI discoverabilityThe title, the buyer and the job the product does, in plain words
2 · Technical clarityAWS services and integrations named, plus numbers an engineer can check
3 · Deployment clarityWhat happens after Subscribe, what the buyer needs first, and how fast it works
4 · Security signalsCertifications, encryption, access control, audit logs and how data is handled
5 · Pricing clarityA unit the buyer can count, explained in the copy, with every price line described
6 · Private-offer readinessContract pricing, private offer requests switched on, and terms like annual or multi-year stated
7 · Protocol & category fitAgent-facing products only: MCP or A2A support declared, APIs named, and the AI platforms you work with

This is the automatic keyword audit's score, not the hand audit's. A typical listing scores low because a missing fact scores zero. Chart scores use the 6 dimensions that apply to every product; agent-facing products are ranked on all 7 against the same listings. Snapshot 29 September 2026. The audit is independent, is not an AWS rating, and does not predict approval, search placement or sales.
